response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1), explicitly states that a quantitative indication (QUID) is required when an ingredient appears in the name of the food or is emphasised on the labelling. The verdict turns on the requirement that 'Wholemeal WHEAT flour' appears in the name and is emphasised, thus triggering the QUID obligation. The clause is directly about this requirement, so it supports the verdict.
